name: project-update-router
description: Routes project update authoring to the right format (interactive microsite, long-form doc, Slidev, dashboard, hybrid PPTX) based on audience + distribution + content-shape + sensitivity. Scaffolds content from beads + git log + gstack learnings. Replaces the default PPTX-for-everything muscle memory with format choice that matches message. v0.1.0 ships interpreter-mode: SKILL.md guides Claude through the workflow manually; automated generators land in v0.2+. Per-project context extensions expected to land alongside via sibling plugins in project repos.
